summary: Create task with title only returns 201 and pending status
description: Verifies AC-1: POST /tasks with a valid title returns a system-generated id, createdAt, and status=pending with HTTP 201.

steps.action: Send POST request to /tasks
steps.expected_result: HTTP 201; response body contains id (non-null), title='Buy milk', status='pending', createdAt (ISO 8601 timestamp), description absent or null

summary: Create task with title and description returns full task object
description: Verifies that an optional description is stored and returned when provided on task creation.

steps.action: Send POST request to /tasks
steps.expected_result: HTTP 201; response body contains the provided title and description alongside system-generated id, status='pending', and createdAt

summary: Create task without title returns 400
description: Verifies AC-2 / E2: POST /tasks with no title field returns HTTP 400 and does not persist a task.

steps.action: Send POST request to /tasks with body missing the title field
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; no task is created; error response body contains a meaningful message

summary: Create task with empty title returns 400
description: Verifies E1: POST /tasks where title is an empty string is rejected with HTTP 400.

steps.action: Send POST request to /tasks with an empty title
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; task is not persisted; error message indicates title is required

summary: Create task with whitespace-only title returns 400
description: Verifies E1: A title consisting entirely of whitespace is treated as empty and rejected.

steps.action: Send POST request to /tasks with a whitespace-only title
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; task is not persisted; error message indicates title cannot be blank

summary: Create task with no request body returns 400
description: Verifies E2: POST /tasks with a completely absent body is rejected gracefully.

steps.action: Send POST request to /tasks with no body
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; meaningful error response; no task is created

summary: Duplicate titles are allowed on task creation
description: Verifies E9: Two tasks may share the same title; uniqueness is enforced on id only.

steps.action: Send POST /tasks twice with the same title
steps.expected_result: Both requests return HTTP 201; each task has a distinct id; both tasks appear in GET /tasks

summary: List all tasks returns all created tasks with full metadata
description: Verifies AC-3: GET /tasks returns an array containing every previously created task including id, title, description, status, and createdAt.

steps.action: Create two tasks via POST /tasks, then send GET /tasks
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200; response is a JSON array of length 2; each element contains id, title, description, status, and createdAt

summary: List tasks on empty store returns empty array
description: Verifies AC-4 / E8: GET /tasks when no tasks exist returns [] with HTTP 200, not an error.

steps.action: Ensure the task store is empty, then send GET /tasks
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200; response body is [] (empty JSON array)

summary: Update task status to completed returns updated task
description: Verifies AC-5: PATCH /tasks/{id} with status=completed returns the updated task object.

steps.action: Create a task via POST /tasks, note the returned id, then send PATCH /tasks/{id}
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200; response contains the same id with status='completed'; title and createdAt are unchanged

summary: Updated status is reflected in subsequent list
description: Verifies AC-5 (persistence): After updating a task, GET /tasks reflects the new status.

steps.action: Create a task, update its status to 'completed' via PATCH, then call GET /tasks
steps.expected_result: The task appears in the list with status='completed'

summary: Update task title only leaves other fields unchanged
description: Verifies PATCH semantics (A6): updating only the title does not erase description or change status.

steps.action: Create a task with title and description; PATCH /tasks/{id} with a new title only
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200; title is updated; description and status remain as originally set

summary: Update task description only leaves other fields unchanged
description: Verifies PATCH semantics: updating only description does not alter title or status.

steps.action: Create a task; PATCH /tasks/{id} with a new description only
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200; description is updated; title and status are unchanged

summary: Update non-existent task returns 404
description: Verifies AC-6 / E3: PATCH /tasks/{id} where id does not match any task returns HTTP 404.

steps.action: Send PATCH request with an id that was never created
steps.expected_result: HTTP 404; meaningful error message; no side effects on existing tasks

summary: Update task with invalid status value returns 400
description: Verifies AC-7 / E6: status values outside the allowed enum (pending|completed) are rejected.

steps.action: Create a task; send PATCH /tasks/{id} with an unsupported status
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; task status is not changed; error response indicates invalid status value

summary: Update task with empty body returns 400
description: Verifies E7: A PATCH request with no updateable fields is rejected rather than silently accepted.

steps.action: Create a task; send PATCH /tasks/{id} with an empty JSON body
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; error response indicates no valid fields were provided

summary: Update request ignores immutable id field
description: Verifies E10 / AC-10: Attempts to change id via PATCH are silently ignored or rejected; the stored id is unchanged.

steps.action: Create a task; note its id; send PATCH /tasks/{id} including a different id in the body
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200 (or 400); the task's id in the store is identical to the original; title update may apply

summary: Update request ignores immutable createdAt field
description: Verifies E10 / AC-10: Attempts to change createdAt via PATCH are silently ignored; timestamp is unchanged.

steps.action: Create a task; note its createdAt; send PATCH /tasks/{id} with a different createdAt value
steps.expected_result: createdAt in the response and in GET /tasks matches the original system-generated value

summary: Delete existing task returns 204 and removes it from list
description: Verifies AC-8: DELETE /tasks/{id} returns HTTP 204 and the task no longer appears in GET /tasks.

steps.action: Create a task; note its id; send DELETE /tasks/{id}; then call GET /tasks
steps.expected_result: DELETE returns HTTP 204 with no body; GET /tasks response does not contain the deleted task's id

summary: Delete non-existent task returns 404
description: Verifies AC-9 / E4: DELETE /tasks/{id} where id does not exist returns HTTP 404 with a meaningful error.

steps.action: Send DELETE request with an id that was never created
steps.expected_result: HTTP 404; meaningful error message; no other tasks are affected

summary: Delete task with malformed id returns 400
description: Verifies E5: A DELETE request with an id of the wrong type or format returns HTTP 400.

steps.action: Send DELETE /tasks/{id} with a malformed id (e.g. special characters, wrong type)
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400; error response indicates invalid id format; no tasks are modified

summary: id is unique across multiple created tasks
description: Verifies data integrity requirement: every created task receives a distinct system-assigned id.

steps.action: Create five tasks in sequence via POST /tasks
steps.data: Five requests each with {"title": "Task N"} where N is 1–5
steps.expected_result: All five response objects have distinct, non-null id values

summary: createdAt is a valid ISO 8601 timestamp and not user-supplied
description: Verifies data integrity requirement: createdAt is system-generated, not accepted from the request body.

steps.action: Send POST /tasks with title only (no createdAt field in body)
steps.expected_result: Response createdAt is a valid ISO 8601 datetime string matching the approximate server time; the field was not echoed from the request

summary: New task default status is pending
description: Verifies that every newly created task has status='pending' regardless of whether a status field is supplied in the request.

steps.action: Send POST /tasks without a status field
steps.expected_result: Response status equals 'pending'

summary: Update status back from completed to pending is allowed
description: Verifies that the status field can be toggled in both directions within the allowed enum.

steps.action: Create a task; set status to 'completed'; then PATCH again with status='pending'
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200; status returns to 'pending'; all other fields unchanged

summary: id and createdAt are identical before and after update
description: Verifies AC-10: Immutable fields retain their original values after a successful PATCH operation.

steps.action: Create a task; record id and createdAt; PATCH the task to change title and status; compare id and createdAt
steps.expected_result: id and createdAt in the PATCH response exactly match the values from the original POST response
